input.message: 建立台北101的基座、八組外挑立面與塔冠

arguments.method: Native editable projected faces and surface grids. One metre is 100 px before projection, equivalent to 1 cm = 1 px. Fixed azimuth 36 degrees, elevation 24 degrees, parallel architectural three-quarter projection. Total height verified; local widths, floor elevations and ornaments estimated from photographs, not as-built survey.

whole.requirement: Entire Taipei 101 from base to spire
whole.description: Recognizable full silhouette, eight projecting bamboo tiers, complete base and spire, no unrelated scenery or decoration.

view.description: Two visible façades and clearly visible top surfaces, consistent foreshortening throughout.

detail.description: Visible façade subdivisions, window frames, projecting ledges, ornamentation, material reflections and self-shadows rather than schematic blocks.

scale.requirement: Real-world dimensions at 1 cm = 1 px before projection
scale.description: 508 m full height represented at 100 px per metre before shared projection; retain estimated local dimensions as estimates.

editable.description: Building surfaces, windows, ornaments and highlights are native editable vector elements, not a raster image.

facts.statement: Taipei 101 architectural height is 508 metres, 101 above-ground floors.
facts.scope: Total height; does not verify individual floor heights or façade dimensions.
facts.verification: CTBUH building record states 508 m architectural height and 101 floors.

facts.statement: Eight eight-storey outward-widening modules rise above the truncated pyramidal base at level 26.
facts.scope: Architectural massing; numerical module width and floor elevations remain illustrative estimates.
facts.verification: Leonard Joseph's structural chapter describes eight eight-storey modules above level 26.

brief.intent: Complete tower base with editable glazing, podium roof and entrance.
assumptions: World units metres. 100 px/m. Local footprint 62m tapering to45.5m, base116m, podium dimensions estimated from photographs.

brief.intent: Eight projecting eight-floor modules with individually editable curtain-wall panels and terrace tops.
assumptions: Module z116..388m, 34m pitch; width45.5m at foot and53m at lip estimated from references.

assumptions: Main roof448m and tip508m; intermediate rooftop shapes and heights estimated.
